# NNNN — <Short Title>

## 1. Description

What is changing and why. Keep it to a few sentences.

## 1.1 Info

| Status       | In progress |
| ------------ | ----------- |
| Last updated | YYYY-MM-DD  |
| Created      | YYYY-MM-DD  |
| ...          | ...         |

Statuses: `Idea` | `Planned` | `In progress` | `Done` | `Abandoned`

Include environment, links, or other essential metadata only when relevant. Keep it short.

## 2. Feature Dev Checklist

Ordered, cascading implementation steps. Each step must be independently actionable and very short.

- [ ] Step 1: Do task A
- [ ] Step 2: Do task B
    - [ ] Step 2.1: Do subtask

## 2.1. Task Details

Additional information for a specific checklist step, only when the step cannot be understood without it.

## 3. Decisions & Rationale

Only if needed.

Record only decisions that materially constrain implementation or explain a non-obvious choice. Never use this as a design diary.

- Decided X because Y
- Did X to avoid Y

## 4. Open Questions

Only genuinely unresolved questions that could affect implementation or scope. Remove questions once they are no longer open.
